declaraciones_responsables_version_ck.name: declaraciones_responsables_version_ck
declaraciones_responsables_version_ck.value:
instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", char(0)) = 0
          and length("declaraciones_responsables"."version") <= 50
          and substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1) glob '[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*'
          and substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1) not glob '*[^0-9.]*'
          and length(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1)) - length(replace(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1), '.', '')) = 2
          and substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1) not glob '0[0-9]*'
          and substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", 1, instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version" || '-', '-') - 1) not glob '*.0[0-9]*'
          and (instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') = 0 or (
            substr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), 1, instr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), '.') - 1) in ('alpha', 'beta', 'rc')
            and substr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), instr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), '.') + 1) glob '[0-9]*'
            and substr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), instr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), '.') + 1) not glob '*[^0-9]*'
            and substr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), instr(substr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", instr("declaraciones_responsables"."version", '-') + 1), '.') + 1) not glob '0[0-9]*'
          ))

verifactu_certificates_dashboard_ck.name: verifactu_certificates_dashboard_ck
verifactu_certificates_dashboard_ck.value: "verifactu_certificates"."source" = 'setup' or ("verifactu_certificates"."person_id" is not null and "verifactu_certificates"."checked_at" is not null and "verifactu_certificates"."checked_endpoint" is not null)

verifactu_history_data_ck.name: verifactu_history_data_ck
verifactu_history_data_ck.value: case when json_valid("verifactu_history"."data") then json_type("verifactu_history"."data") = 'object' else 0 end

verifactu_history_confirmed_shape_ck.name: verifactu_history_confirmed_shape_ck
verifactu_history_confirmed_shape_ck.value:
"verifactu_history"."kind" <> 'clock.confirmed' or coalesce(
        json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.confirmedAt') = 'text'
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.stepMs') = 'integer'
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.proof') = 'object',
        0
      )

verifactu_history_confirmed_links_ck.name: verifactu_history_confirmed_links_ck

verifactu_history_observed_ck.name: verifactu_history_observed_ck
verifactu_history_observed_ck.value:
"verifactu_history"."kind" <> 'conflict.observed' or coalesce(
        "verifactu_history"."registro_id" is not null
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.attempt') = 'integer'
        and json_extract("verifactu_history"."data", '$.attempt') > 0
        and json_extract("verifactu_history"."data", '$.cause') in ('fiscal.huella_divergente', 'fiscal.duplicado_anulado')
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.evidence') is not null
        and "verifactu_history"."person_id" is null
        and "verifactu_history"."event_key" = 'conflict:' || "verifactu_history"."registro_id" || ':' || json_extract("verifactu_history"."data", '$.attempt') || ':' || json_extract("verifactu_history"."data", '$.cause'),
        0
      )

verifactu_history_lookup_ck.name: verifactu_history_lookup_ck
verifactu_history_lookup_ck.value:
"verifactu_history"."kind" <> 'conflict.lookup' or coalesce(
        "verifactu_history"."registro_id" is not null
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.evidence') is not null
        and "verifactu_history"."person_id" is null
        and "verifactu_history"."event_key" = 'lookup:' || "verifactu_history"."registro_id",
        0
      )

verifactu_history_note_ck.name: verifactu_history_note_ck
verifactu_history_note_ck.value:
"verifactu_history"."kind" <> 'case.note' or coalesce(
        "verifactu_history"."registro_id" is not null and "verifactu_history"."person_id" is not null
        and substr("verifactu_history"."event_key", 1, 10) = 'case.note:' and length("verifactu_history"."event_key") > 10
        and json_type("verifactu_history"."data", '$.action') = 'text',
        0
      )

verifactu_records_tipo_factura_rectifica.name: verifactu_records_tipo_factura_rectificativa_ck
verifactu_records_tipo_factura_rectifica.value: "verifactu_records"."tipo_rectificativa" is null or ("verifactu_records"."tipo_factura" is not null and "verifactu_records"."tipo_factura" glob 'R[1-5]')

verifactu_records_facturas_sustituidas_f.name: verifactu_records_facturas_sustituidas_f3_ck
verifactu_records_facturas_sustituidas_f.value: "verifactu_records"."facturas_sustituidas" is null or ("verifactu_records"."tipo_factura" is not null and "verifactu_records"."tipo_factura" = 'F3')

verifactu_records_encadenamiento_ck.name: verifactu_records_encadenamiento_ck
verifactu_records_encadenamiento_ck.value:
("verifactu_records"."primer_registro"
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_id_emisor_factura" is null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_num_serie_factura" is null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_fecha_expedicion_factura" is null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_huella" is null)
           or (not "verifactu_records"."primer_registro"
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_id_emisor_factura" is not null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_num_serie_factura" is not null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_fecha_expedicion_factura" is not null
             and "verifactu_records"."anterior_huella" is not null)

verifactu_submissions_case_ck.name: verifactu_submissions_case_ck
verifactu_submissions_case_ck.value:
("verifactu_submissions"."case_cause" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_evidence" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_cause" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_opened_at" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_cause" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_open_seq" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_cause" is null or "verifactu_submissions"."case_cause" <> '')

verifactu_submissions_resolution_ck.name: verifactu_submissions_resolution_ck
verifactu_submissions_resolution_ck.value:
("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_at" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_by" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_at" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolution_action" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_at" is null) = ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolution_key" is null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_at" is null or "verifactu_submissions"."case_opened_at" is not null)
        and ("verifactu_submissions"."case_remedy_registro_id" is null or
          ("verifactu_submissions"."case_resolved_at" is not null and "verifactu_submissions"."case_remedy_registro_id" <> "verifactu_submissions"."registro_id"))
